title: Removing a linked list node
summary: Redirect the predecessor node's successor reference to bypass the node being removed.
context: The local sublist is n0 (1) → P (0) → n1 (3) → …. Given predecessor n0, the goal is to delete node P; n0 is not necessarily the head of the entire list.
description: The figure has upper and lower panels; after deletion, P and its arrow to n1 turn dashed and remain visible for comparison, while memory deallocation is not depicted.
result: Given predecessor node n0, redirecting a single reference takes O(1) time and no other nodes need to move; the time to locate the predecessor is not included in this step.

frames.title: Removing a linked list node
frames.explanation: After executing n0.next = n1, the main chain becomes n0 (1) → n1 (3) → …. Although P.next still points to n1, traversing forward from the list head through n0 can no longer reach P, so logical deletion is complete.

prose.title: Removing a linked list node
prose.summary: Redirect the predecessor node's successor reference to bypass the node being removed.
context: The local sublist is n0 (1) → P (0) → n1 (3) → …. Given predecessor n0, the goal is to delete node P; n0 is not necessarily the head of the entire list.
description: The figure has upper and lower panels; after deletion, P and its arrow to n1 turn dashed and remain visible for comparison, while memory deallocation is not depicted.
prose.result: Given predecessor node n0, redirecting a single reference takes O(1) time and no other nodes need to move; the time to locate the predecessor is not included in this step.

steps.title: Before deletion: n0 → P → n1
steps.explanation: Current links are n0 (1) → P (0) → n1 (3) → …. Here n0.next points to P and P.next points to n1, so starting from n0 must pass through P to reach n1. Next, n0.next will be redirected.
steps.key_state: Before deletion, n0 → P → n1, and P is reachable from n0.
steps.announcement: Before deletion: n0, P, and n1 are linked in sequence, ready to bypass node P.

steps.title: Redirect reference: n0.next = n1
steps.explanation: Execute n0.next = n1, changing the main chain to n0 (1) → n1 (3) → …. Node P (0)'s next still points to n1, but forward traversal from the list head past n0 can no longer reach P, completing logical deletion.
steps.key_state: n0.next = n1, so the main chain becomes n0 → n1; P is unreachable though it still points to n1.
steps.announcement: Set n0.next directly to n1 so node P becomes unreachable from the list, completing deletion.
